correctness.rationale: Equation (1) follows exactly from directed rate updates; independent Walsh coefficients force edge conditions and graph harmonicity; connectedness and two boundary values normalize the only affine candidate; positive discordant transition rates guarantee finite a.s. absorption and Dirichlet uniqueness. No reliance on empirical extrapolation.

value.rationale: Site-dependent personal preferences usually destroy classical unbiased fixation conservation; this theorem identifies exactly when a natural degree-weighted martingale survives, for all finite connected graph topologies and every initial spin assignment. The bipartite/odd-cycle dichotomy is a motivated structural obstruction and provides nontrivial, all-size exact tests for partisan social diffusion.
